description: Community Collaborative Rain Hail & Snow Network (CoCoRaHS) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; NSF, National Science Foundation. CoCoRaHS is an acronym for the Co mmunity Co llaborative R ain, H ail and S now network. This citizen science project encourages volunteers to measure and report daily precipitation at their location. Every day, volunteers across the country measure and report precipitation (rain, hail and snow) amounts. Reports are compiled into publicly accessible maps. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Severe Winter Weather. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
